headline: Fourteen-year-old girl who gave birth to "Baby Angelita" found in Mexico, father in custody.
summary: The 14-year-old who gave birth to an infant found dead in Moss Landing, and her father, Sergio Galvez Perez, who authorities suspect raped her, were found by Mexican authorities, the Monterey County Sheriff's Office announced Sunday…
source: Monterey County Weekly / Monterey County NOW
